title: K-flat left derivability under exact integer-indexed colimits
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a monoidal structure [def-sfb-monoidal-category] whose tensor product is additive in each variable. Assume countable coproducts and colimits indexed by the ordered category $(\mathbf Z,\leq)$ exist [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], the latter colimit functor preserves short exact sequences, and tensoring on either side with any fixed object preserves these coproducts and these integer-indexed colimits. A flat object means an object whose tensor functors on both sides preserve short exact sequences. Assume there is a functor $P:C\to C$ with flat values and a natural epimorphism $P\Rightarrow\mathrm{id}_C$. Use unbounded cochain complexes and quasi-isomorphisms as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and two-sided direct-sum total-tensor K-flatness as in [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso]. Let $K(C)$ have complexes as objects and cochain maps modulo cochain homotopy as morphisms: $f,g:X\to Y$ are homotopic if $f^n-g^n=d_Y^{n-1}h^n+h^{n+1}d_X^n$ for maps $h^n:X^n\to Y^{n-1}$ in every degree. Write $W$ for its quasi-isomorphisms, and let $i:K_{\mathrm{fl}}(C)\hookrightarrow K(C)$ be the full inclusion of K-flat complexes, equipped with $W_{\mathrm{fl}}=i^{-1}W$. Then this inclusion is a left derivability structure in the sense of [def-sfb-left-derivability-structure].
